visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dark car interior featuring star-like glowing ceiling lights, a young woman with a long dark braid and a camouflage tank top holds a smartphone to her face, performing a dramatic scene with exaggerated facial expressions. (2) The camera pans quickly to the driver's seat where a young man wearing glasses and a white dress shirt turns around with a sharp, angry expression, gesturing aggressively with his right hand toward the passenger. (3) The scene shifts back to the woman who appears startled and wide-eyed; she whispers urgently into her phone while looking around the dimly lit cabin, which is partially illuminated by the light of the smartphone screen. (4) A motorized car door slides open from the outside, revealing bright daylight; the male driver is seen from the exterior, reaching into the backseat with a forceful arm gesture to evict the passenger. (5) The woman is pulled out of the luxury van onto a grassy roadside under bright afternoon sun; the man continues to lecture her with animated gestures while she looks back at the vehicle in disbelief. (6) A transition cut shows a different woman inside a similar luxury vehicle, wearing a white tank top and baseball cap while reclining in a premium leather seat; she interacts with a smartphone interface. (7) Close-up shots detail the car's premium interior features, including soft grey leather armrests, spacious legroom with a 'LEXUS' branded floor mat, and a bottle of 'evian' water placed in a dedicated cup holder. (8) The camera focuses on the 'Starry Sky' ceiling feature in complete darkness, showing thousands of tiny white and blue glowing dots, before concluding with a social media profile screenshot on a white background.

(2) A sudden increase in volume occurs as a male voice interrupts with an aggressive, shouting tone; his speech is loud and authoritative, accompanied by the rustling sound of movement. (3) The BGM continues as the woman's voice drops to a low-volume, breathy whisper; the low-frequency hum of a car engine is slightly audible in the quiet moments. (4) A distinct mechanical sliding sound of a motorized door triggers a shift; the man's voice is heard from a different acoustic perspective, shouting with high intensity and sharp articulation. (5) Sounds of physical scuffing and clothing rustle are prominent as the passenger is evicted; the shouting remains dominant until a hard audio transition occurs. (6) A new, calm lo-fi BGM with a steady beat begins as a narrative female voice with a professional, friendly tone provides a clear, well-enunciated explanation of car features. (7) High-pitched digital UI sound effects, such as clicks and pops, are synchronized with narrative pauses, while a soft ambient room tone representing the car's interior persists. (8) The narration remains stable in volume as it describes feature costs; the music maintains a consistent lo-fi texture before fading out during the final segment.
